title: 第七章功法谬误可推演第八章卖地风波
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
{技能：残缺版开元炼体术“一次淬体篇”，内容有谬误，不适合宿主修炼……}
这行字浮现出来后，下方那些如瀑布一般浮现在面板上的字体和修炼图录也就紧跟着消失，像是被人用无形的橡皮擦擦掉了，不复存在。
不行吗？
顾晦皱着眉头，吐出一口浊气。
当初，父亲顾长青从黑市花了三两白银买来了这本秘籍，勉强成功进行了一次淬体，实力虽然有增强，身体却也受到了反噬，秋冬之际，咳嗽非常厉害。
原来，这门功法不但残缺，还有谬误啊！
顾晦叹了口气，准备收起面板，然而，面板还在变化，下方又浮现出了一行字体。
{技能：残缺版开元炼体术“一次淬体篇”，内容有谬误，可推演为适合宿主修炼……}
{是否推演？}
{所需条件：全神贯注修炼残缺版开元炼体术“一次淬体篇”一次……}
{推演时间：三个时辰。}
竟然还有转折！
全神贯注修炼一次，之后，消耗三个时辰时间推演就能推演出适合自己修炼的没有错漏的开元炼体术，也就是说，等自己睡一晚起来之后就会有正确的功法修炼。
确定没有问题后，顾晦不再犹豫，选择了是。
之后，他把册子揣在怀里，走出堂屋，来到了院子内，先去了一趟厨房。
厨房内，顾瑜坐在灶台前烧火，母亲靠着灶台出神，锅里面白雾升腾，应该是在热剩菜剩饭。
“娘，我在后院，饭菜好了喊我……”
顾晦出声说道。
“好！”
徐翠娘回头应了一声，神情依旧恍惚。

顾晦绕过屋子，来到了后院，后院不大，靠着土坡，土坡上生长着一片竹林，没有院墙，只是用竹子和泥土扎了一道一人高的篱笆绕着土坡围着屋子。
站在院子中间，背靠屋子，面向土坡，顾晦深吸了一口气。
开元炼体术一共有九个桩功姿势，每个桩功姿势都配合着特殊的呼吸吐纳之术，从易到难，开始很简单，越到后面越难，最后两三个姿势有点像前世阿三苦修士修炼的瑜伽。
顾晦不认为现在的自己能够做到。
他依稀记得，当初自己的父亲花了半年的时间这才将九个桩功姿势练成。
至于淬体，又花了一年的时间才做到。
不过，面板并没有要求自己能够一次性地把九个桩功姿势全部练成，自己只需要全神贯注竭尽全力地练一次便是。
于是，顾晦拉开拳架，摆下了第一个姿势。
面板的缘故，他对这九个桩功姿势已然烂熟于心，配合的呼吸吐纳的法门也记得清清楚楚，稍微调整了片刻，也就把这个桩功姿势摆好，按照要求呼吸吐纳。
感觉？
的确有感觉！
不过，并非什么神功大成的感觉！
而是感觉说不出的别扭、难受，心里憋得慌，按照册子上的记载，他需得维持这个桩功姿势十几个呼吸的时间，顾晦也就忍受着，尽量投入进去。
之后，第二个姿势！
同样的感受，别扭、难受！
content_en:
{Skill: The incomplete version of the Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique "One Body Tempering Chapter", the content contains fallacies and is not suitable for the host to practice...}
After this line of words appeared, the fonts and cultivation illustrations that appeared on the panel like a waterfall below also disappeared, as if someone had wiped them away with an invisible eraser and ceased to exist.
No?
Gu Hui frowned and let out a breath.
At first, his father, Gu Changqing, spent three taels of silver on the black market to buy this secret book, and barely succeeded in tempering the body. Although his strength increased, his body also suffered backlash. During autumn and winter, he coughed very badly.
It turns out that this practice is not only incomplete, but also fallacious!
Gu Hui sighed and prepared to put away the panel. However, the panel was still changing, and another line of font appeared below.
{Skill: The incomplete version of the Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique "One Time Tempering Chapter", the content contains fallacies and can be deduced to be suitable for the host to practice...}
{Deduction? }
{Required conditions: Concentrate on practicing the incomplete version of Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique "One Body Tempering Chapter" once...}
{Deduction time: three hours. }
There is a twist!
Concentrate on practicing once, and then spend three hours deducing the Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique that is suitable for your practice without any mistakes. In other words, you will have the correct technique to practice after you wake up after a night's sleep.
After confirming that there was no problem, Gu Hui no longer hesitated and chose yes.
After that, he put the book in his arms, walked out of the main room, came to the yard, and went to the kitchen first.
In the kitchen, Gu Yu was sitting in front of the stove and lighting a fire. Her mother was leaning against the stove in trance. White mist was rising from the pot, which must have been leftovers being heated.
"Mom, I'm in the backyard. Call me when the food is ready..."
Gu Hui said aloud.
"Okay!"
Xu Cuiniang turned around and responded, her expression still dazed.
Gu Hui walked around the house and came to the backyard. The backyard was not big, leaning on a slope. There was a bamboo forest growing on the slope. There was no courtyard wall, but a fence as high as one person was made of bamboo and soil that went around the slope to surround the house.
Standing in the middle of the yard, with his back to the house and facing the slope, Gu Hui took a deep breath.
There are a total of nine postures in the Kaiyuan Exercise, and each posture is matched with a special breathing technique. It starts from easy to difficult, and the beginning is very simple, and the later it becomes more difficult. The last two or three postures are a bit like the yoga practiced by the ascetic monk Asan in the previous life.
Gu Hui didn't think he could do it now.
He vaguely remembered that it took his father half a year to practice the nine postures.
As for body tempering, it took another year to do it.
However, the board does not require that you can practice all nine postures at once. You only need to concentrate on practicing it with all your strength.
So, Gu Hui opened his fists and took the first stance.
Because of the panel, he was already familiar with these nine postures, and he also remembered the corresponding breathing method clearly. After adjusting for a moment, he put the postures in place and breathed according to the requirements.
Feel?
It does feel like it!
However, it doesn’t feel like a great achievement!
Instead, he felt indescribably awkward and uncomfortable, and felt panicked. According to the records in the booklet, he needed to maintain this posture for more than ten breaths, so Gu Hui endured it and devoted himself to it as much as possible.
After that, the second pose!
The same feeling, awkward and uncomfortable!
